hooks.name: Copy guard
hooks.description: When user-facing copy is saved (lib/i18n/*.ts, components/*.tsx|ts, or app/**/*.tsx), run copy-guard on the saved file: flags forbidden eligibility phrases (EN + ES + PT + HT + ZH) and English copy above an 8th-grade reading level. Appends each run (timestamp, file path, output, exit code) to tests/hook-copy-guard.log.

action.command: $in = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); try { $j = $in | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { $j = $null }; $f = if ($j) { if ($j.filePath) { $j.filePath } elseif ($j.file) { $j.file } else { '' } } else { '' }; $cmd = if ($f) { "node tests/copy-guard.mjs `"$f`" 2>&1" } else { 'node tests/copy-guard.mjs 2>&1' }; $out = (cmd /c $cmd | Out-String).TrimEnd(); $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $ts = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ'); Add-Content -Path 'tests/hook-copy-guard.log' -Value "[$ts] file=$f exit=$code`n$out`n"; Write-Output $out; exit $code
